title: Can I SURVIVE Seirawan Chess?
summary: The creator plays Seirawan (S-Chess) online against higher-rated humans, aiming for three wins (3|2 clock). Each side has two extra reserve pieces, the Elephant (rook+knight) and the Hawk (bishop+knight), which can be placed only on the square a back-rank piece vacates when it moves for the first time. He plays a London setup, gates the hawk behind the bishop and the elephant behind a knight, and wins games including by flag.
rules: Standard chess plus two reserve pieces per side: Elephant (moves as rook + knight) and Hawk (moves as bishop + knight).
A reserve piece may be placed only when a piece on the back rank moves for the first time; it is dropped onto the vacated square as part of that move (optional - 'continue without placing a piece').
Once all original back-rank pieces have moved, any unplaced reserve piece is lost.
Castling may place a reserve piece on the king's or rook's vacated square (standard S-chess; inferred).
win_condition: Checkmate (or flag). Goal: 3 wins vs higher-rated humans.
